Class BitmapFactory

java.lang.Object
icyllis.modernui.graphics.BitmapFactory
public final class BitmapFactory extends Object
Creates Bitmaps from encoded data.

This class provides static methods for decoding encoded image data from various sources into pixel maps (i.e. Bitmaps).

The following image formats are supported:

Supported Formats
Format NameMIME TypeTypical Extensions
PNGimage/png.png
GIFimage/gif.gif
JPEGimage/jpeg.jpg, .jpeg, .jfif
TIFFimage/tiff.tiff, .tif
Radiance HDRimage/vnd.radiance.hdr
Netpbm PGMimage/x-portable-graymap.pgm
Netpbm PPMimage/x-portable-pixmap.ppm, .pnm

Decoding is supported from the following input sources:

  • File
  • Path
  • InputStream
  • ReadableByteChannel
  • byte[]
  • ByteBuffer

For each input source, a corresponding decode*Info method is provided. These methods parse only the metadata (dimensions, format, and MIME type) without decoding or allocating memory for the underlying pixel data.

All methods can be called from any thread, but it is recommended to call them from a worker thread.

Since:
3.7

    • decodeFile

      @NonNull public static Bitmap decodeFile(@NonNull File file) throws IOException
      Decode a file path into an immutable bitmap.

      If the file cannot be decoded into a bitmap, the method throws IOException on the halfway.

      Parameters:
      file - the file to be decoded
      Returns:
      the decoded bitmap
      Throws:
      IOException - the file cannot be decoded into a bitmap

    • decodeFile

      @NonNull public static Bitmap decodeFile(@NonNull File file, @Nullable BitmapFactory.Options opts) throws IOException
      Decode a file path into a bitmap.

      If the file cannot be decoded into a bitmap, the method throws IOException on the halfway. If the specified color space is not RGB, or if the specified color space's transfer function is not an ICC parametric curve, the method throws IllegalArgumentException.

      Parameters:
      file - the file to be decoded
      opts - the decoder options
      Returns:
      the decoded bitmap
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - the options are invalid
      IOException - the file cannot be decoded into a bitmap

    • decodeStream

      @NonNull public static Bitmap decodeStream(@NonNull InputStream stream) throws IOException
      Decode an input stream into an immutable bitmap.

      The stream's position will be undefined after being called. This method does not closed the given stream after read operation has completed.

      If the stream cannot be decoded into a bitmap, the method throws IOException on the halfway.

      Parameters:
      stream - the input stream to be decoded
      Returns:
      the decoded bitmap
      Throws:
      IOException - the data cannot be decoded into a bitmap

    • decodeBuffer

      @NonNull public static Bitmap decodeBuffer(@NonNull ByteBuffer buffer, @Nullable BitmapFactory.Options opts) throws IOException
      Decode a bitmap from the specified byte buffer. The buffer may be a heap buffer or a direct buffer. The decoder starts from the current Buffer.position() and read Buffer.remaining() bytes at most. And the buffer's position will remain unchanged after the call.

      If the buffer cannot be decoded into a bitmap, the method throws IOException on the halfway. If the specified color space is not RGB, or if the specified color space's transfer function is not an ICC parametric curve, the method throws IllegalArgumentException.

      Parameters:
      buffer - byte buffer of compressed image data
      opts - the decoder options
      Returns:
      the decoded bitmap
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - the options are invalid
      IOException - the data cannot be decoded into a bitmap
      Since:
      3.13
